post_topic: Why LLM-agnostic architecture isn't a nice-to-have — it's the only production-safe design decision
scene_description: A layered architectural diagram showing an orchestration abstraction layer sitting between an application and three interchangeable model APIs — GPT-4, Claude, and a fine-tuned open-source model — with a state machine branching point that routes outputs failing schema validation to a HITL review queue before they can reach business logic. The left side of the diagram shows hardcoded model names (GPT-4 in a config file, Claude in a prompt template, Gemini in a pipeline block) labeled as the fragile before-state, while the right side shows the normalized interface contract of Cloud Decoded's architecture as the durable after-state. The setting is a technical architecture illustration with no human figures, emphasizing the structural contrast between code-dependency coupling and runtime-config flexibility.
